speaker: Doctor

text: I haven't had any fever, weight loss, or night sweats. However, I have been feeling short of breath when I exert myself and have been experiencing dizziness. speaker: Doctor
text: The pain in your fingers that improves with cold is a classic sign of Raynaud's phenomenon, which, combined with your fatigue and the confirmed imaging, points to a specific autoimmune condition. DIAGNOSIS READY: Systemic Sclerosis (Scleroderma)
